category.label: Neuropixels
category.description: High-density silicon probes (Neuropixels 1.0/2.0) with hundreds to thousands of recording sites per shank for large-scale extracellular spike and LFP recording in rodents and non-human primates.

parameters.name: Recording sites
parameters.notes: NP2.0 doubles density with switchable sites.

pitfalls.issue: Probe drift over hours corrupts unit tracking
pitfalls.mitigation: Kilosort 2.5+ drift correction; report % of stable units
Use tissue reference; verify CAR reduces noise floor
